name: agent-bridge
displayName: Agent Bridge (DSH · Codex · Claude Code · Antigravity)
description: Controller tools for multi-harness work: delegate bounded tasks to DeepSeek Harness workers (dsh_project bridge_* tools) and consult, cross-review or appoint another harness (Codex, Claude Code or Antigravity) as sub-controller (agent_peer peer_* tools), with one root controller per task and no delegation loops.
